summary: Lets a fleet drop the last two shared node secrets. Server: the console drain finding it records for itself (RESOURCE_ENROLLMENT_DASHBOARD_PARTICIPANT=absent) is signed with the server Ed25519 key (keyId stored, verifies across rotation) instead of RESULT_SIGNING_SECRET, the host-local and OS scheduler writer proofs are fetched whether or not RESULT_SIGNING_SECRET is set (agents sign them with their node key), and evidence and findings stored with the shared key verify from RESULT_SIGNING_PREVIOUS_SECRET alone. Agent: COMMAND_RECONCILIATION_PREVIOUS_SECRET is a verify-only slot for historical-mutation settlements and recorded decisions; magnus-agent historical-settlements list | reseal | prune --unverifiable reports how each settlement verifies, re-MACs those signed with a shared key with the node-local keys, and archives those no key verifies to a root-only directory (dry run by default). No migrations. Mixes with 3.0.1 in both directions. See docs/NODE_CREDENTIALS.md, Retiring the shared keys.

newOptionalEnv.name: RESULT_SIGNING_PREVIOUS_SECRET
newOptionalEnv.description: Verify-only previous value of RESULT_SIGNING_SECRET: evidence and console drain findings stored with it keep verifying; nothing new is signed with it. Move RESULT_SIGNING_SECRET here to retire the shared key.

newOptionalEnv.name: COMMAND_RECONCILIATION_PREVIOUS_SECRET
newOptionalEnv.description: Verify-only previous value of COMMAND_RECONCILIATION_SECRET: historical-mutation settlements and recorded decisions stored with it keep verifying; nothing new is signed with it. After magnus-agent historical-settlements reseal --apply it can be removed.
